meta.tagline: Statelessness, MRTR, Streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 and tool poisoning: the MCP that AI Engineer interviews really probe.
meta.description: A 450-question bank weighted toward advanced and tricky questions, served as 40-question, 60-minute mocks, targeting MCP specification revision 2026-07-28 (with the 2025-era initialize-based revisions it must interoperate with), the Python SDK 2.3 (MCPServer, formerly FastMCP) and the TypeScript SDK v2 (@modelcontextprotocol/server 2.3). Covers architecture and JSON-RPC, transports and version negotiation, tools and tool design, resources and prompts, elicitation and multi round-trip requests, both SDKs, clients and the Inspector, OAuth 2.1 authorization, and security, deployment and scaling of remote servers. Every option explains its reasoning.
